videos.headline: Corey Gammage capitalizes on UConn's fumble for a Marshall TD
videos.description: Marshall's Charlie Gray recovers the fumble, then Corey Gammage climbs the ladder for an impressive touchdown snag.

videos.headline: Big man TD! Damion Barber takes the INT 34 yards to the house
videos.description: Damion Barber snags the interception and returns it 34 yards to extend the Thundering Herd's lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Big man TD! Damion Barber takes the INT 34 yards to the house) 2022/12/19 ESHEET
